overview: Hanami’s settings tune charged attacks, a rapid flower burst, root traps, and homing walls at different cursed-energy levels.
technicalOverview: Hanami (CP_150) uses UCP_150_ActionController with eight populated unique rows. The values divide into a small shared tuning row, a held third-attack charge, the flower-machine-gun burst, level-specific root traps (including Auto overrides), and three cursed-energy-2 homing-wall rows. Row numbers are zero-based positions in CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterUnique, and trap behaviours read the same values through GetUniqueFloat/GetCharacterUniqueFloatValue. Effects below are traced from reconstructed source; where a downstream helper is shared, the entry says so.

CP_150.title: Core timing and plant-pattern scale factors
CP_150.overview: One normal-attack interruption cutoff, three speed divisors for the level-specific root trap, and three divisors used only when the passive buff is active. The trailing zero slots have no CP_150-specific read in the traced source.

0.label: Projectile hold cutoff
0.simple: How long the first normal attack keeps waiting while its projectiles are still alive.
0.technical: In TCP_150_NormalAttack_1::TickAttack on start count 0 and phase 1, with a non-empty CollectedEffects list and at least one effect not finished: ActionElapsedTime increases and the tick returns while 0.3 > ActionElapsedTime. Once that strict test fails, every collected effect has attack and damage collisions disabled and its movement controller reset; the action sets Byte16, PhaseUnbounded and flag159. This is a time in seconds from DeltaTime accumulation.

1.label: Root trap speed divisor, level 1
1.simple: How much pattern 1 stretches Hanami's level-1 root-trap wind-up and rise.
1.technical: FGameTrapAction_PlantRootMove reads value 1 of row 0 only when the trap source has material pattern 1 and SpawnCursedEnergyLevel == 1. Speed is 1.5; Rate is Speed != 0 ? 1/Speed : 1, and Rate multiplies both the initial Timer (from row 3 value 6, or row 7 value 2 for auto) and the rise/spin duration from row 3 value 0 (or row 7 value 0 for auto). Without pattern 1 Speed stays 1.

2.label: Root trap speed divisor, level 2
2.simple: How much pattern 1 stretches Hanami's level-2 root-trap wind-up and rise.
2.technical: Same PlantRootMove pattern-1 gate as value 1, selected when SpawnCursedEnergyLevel == 2. Speed is 2; Rate = 1/2, applied to the initial Timer (row 3 value 7) and the rise duration (row 3 value 1). The nonzero guard falls back to Rate 1 if the value were zero.

3.label: Root trap speed divisor, level 3
3.simple: How much pattern 1 stretches Hanami's level-3 root-trap wind-up and rise.
3.technical: Same PlantRootMove pattern-1 gate, selected when SpawnCursedEnergyLevel == 3. Speed is 3; Rate = 1/3, applied to the initial Timer (row 3 value 8) and the rise duration (row 3 value 2).

4.label: Passive homing interval divisor, level 1
4.simple: Pattern-1 multiplier that slows level-1 homing-wall waves; also the level-1 wall speed divisor.
4.technical: Two traced uses. (1) UCP_150_ActionController::AddHomingShot uses this as Divisor only when BUFF_CP_150_PASSIVE has a stack > 0 and the controller cursed energy level is 1; ScaledInterval = (Divisor != 0 ? 1/Divisor : 1) * row 4 value 4. With no passive stack Divisor stays 1. (2) FGameTrapAction_PlantWall uses value 4 of row 0 as its pattern-1 Speed for level 1, then Rate = Speed != 0 ? 1/Speed : 1 multiplies the rise duration from row 4 value 5.

5.label: Passive homing interval divisor, level 2
5.simple: Pattern-1 multiplier that slows level-2 homing-wall waves; also the level-2 wall speed divisor.
5.technical: Same two uses as value 4, selected for cursed energy level 2: passive-stack divisor for row 5 value 4 in AddHomingShot, and PlantWall pattern-1 Speed for the rise duration from row 5 value 5. Zero divisor guards keep the original interval/duration.

6.label: Passive homing interval divisor, level 3
6.simple: Pattern-1 multiplier that slows level-3 homing-wall waves; also the level-3 wall speed divisor.
6.technical: Same two uses, selected for cursed energy level 3: passive-stack divisor for row 6 value 4 in AddHomingShot, and PlantWall pattern-1 Speed for the rise duration from row 6 value 5. The passive stack test is GetBuffDebuffStack(CP_150_Passive, nullptr) > 0.

notes.text: The row number is the zero-based position in CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterUnique; the optional row list is copied in order into UniqueRows, and the float getter is an unchecked UniqueRows[Row]->FloatValue[Value] dereference, so a missing row is not given a default here.
Material pattern 1 is the switch that both applies BUFF_CP_150_PASSIVE and turns on the row-0/row-4..6 speed divisors used by the plant traps.

CP_150_ATTACKD.title: NormalAttack_3_1 charge values
CP_150_ATTACKD.overview: Holding the third normal attack builds charge; these values set the cutoff and the two resource gain rates. The cutoff is compared strictly, so the charge can pass it on the next tick.

0.label: Maximum charge time
0.simple: How long the held third attack can keep charging.
0.technical: TickCharge accumulates ChargeTime while bChargeActive is set. On the finishing start count (1 for ground type 58, 3 for air type 70), the action keeps waiting only while EGameInputKey::NormalAttack_3 is held and 5 > ChargeTime. Once that strict comparison fails it sets Byte16, PhaseUnbounded and flag159 and clears bChargeActive. Unit: seconds of DeltaTime.

1.label: Cursed energy experience per second
1.simple: How much attack experience the charge gives while the gauge is not at its threshold.
1.technical: When bChargeActive is set and IsCursedEnergyGaugeAtThreshold() is false, TickCharge calls AddCursedEnergyExp(30 * DeltaTime). The threshold predicate is LevelThreshold[Unknown170] <= CursedEnergyGauge; this is the experience branch, not gauge gain.

2.label: Cursed energy gauge per second
2.simple: How much cursed energy gauge the charge gives once the current level threshold is met.
2.technical: When bChargeActive is set and IsCursedEnergyGaugeAtThreshold() is true, TickCharge calls AddCursedEnergy(35 * DeltaTime) instead of the experience branch. Rate is per second and is multiplied by DeltaTime.

notes.text: Charge only starts when the action's slot-3 notify fires (UniqueAction sets bChargeActive; both notify parameters are ignored). Reset clears ChargeTime and the flag at start count 0.

CP_150_ATTACKF.title: FlowerMachineGun / trap-shot burst values
CP_150_ATTACKF.overview: Values used by the TR_020_00 flower trap and the three-stage hand-off to the character controller: a short notify delay, the trap's own lifetime, the burst's timing and size, and a placement clamp.

0.label: Notify delay after setup
0.simple: How long the flower waits before signalling the character's actions again.
0.technical: In FGameTrapAction_FlowerMachineGun::Tick state 3, Delay is read from value 0 of row 2 and compared with a per-state Timer. Here it is 0, so once state 3 begins, Delay <= Timer is true on that tick and PlayUniqueAction(1, 0.0) is forwarded to the source character. A null source would substitute 0.

1.label: Flower lifetime after hand-off
1.simple: How long the flower trap remains active after starting its burst.
1.technical: In FlowerMachineGun state 6, Timer accumulates and the trap calls Finish() once 1 <= Timer. This begins after state 5 has called UCP_150_ActionController::StartTrapShot with the trap location, target location and target actor.

2.label: Trap-shot phase 0 wait
2.simple: How long the controller waits before placing the burst marker.
2.technical: TickTrapShot only runs while TrapShot.bActive. Its phase timer uses DeltaTime divided by CustomTimeDilation when that value is positive, otherwise raw DeltaTime. Phase 0 returns until PhaseTime >= 2 seconds; then it refreshes the target location, clamps XY distance and snaps the marker to ground before spawning the DCL_80200 decal and SE_CP_150_01361.

3.label: Trap-shot phase 1 wait
3.simple: How long the marker stays before the burst and ground drops appear.
3.technical: Phase 1 returns until PhaseTime >= 0.5 seconds. It then reads value 5 of this row as Radius, spawns FX_CP_150_06111 with that Niagara Radius and capsule radius, places nine FX_CP_150_06112/06122 drops, and fades the decal.

4.label: Trap-shot phase 2 wait
4.simple: How long the burst remains before the controller releases its effects.
4.technical: Phase 2 accumulates the same dilation-adjusted timer and calls FCP_150_TrapShotState::Release() once PhaseTime >= 2 seconds. Release finishes pooled effects, fades the decal and stops the 3D sound.

5.label: Burst radius and decal size
5.simple: How wide the burst marker and its effect are.
5.technical: One value feeds several places in phase 0/1: decal Size.Y and Size.Z are set to 500, the FX_CP_150_06111 Niagara Radius parameter and capsule radius/collision-manager request use 500, the eight outer ground drops are offset by Radius * 0.5, and each drop is scaled by Radius * 0.002. These are world-space distances used by FVector and capsule calls.

6.label: Trap placement clamp distance
6.simple: How far the burst can be pulled away from the flower's origin.
6.technical: In phase 0, if the 2-D distance from TrapShot.TrapLocation to TrapShot.TrapOrigin exceeds 3000 world-space units, the location is reset to TrapOrigin plus the normalized XY direction times 3000. The Z is then cleared before ground snapping.

notes.text: TR_020_00 is spawned by NormalAttack_2's notify 0 after a short backward trace; the air form's notify 1 additionally sets flag159. The trap's notify 1 is broadcast by the action controller to every active layer action's slot 3.
StartTrapShot only copies From, To and Target and arms the shot; all row-2 timing and geometry is consumed later by TickTrapShot from the controller's ActionTick.

CP_150_ATTACKG.title: Root-rise trap (cursed energy 1) values
CP_150_ATTACKG.overview: Level-specific timings for the TR_030_00 PlantRootMove trap: start delay, rise time, placement range and how long the trap waits before finishing. Auto versions override three of these from ATTACKG_AUTO.

0.label: Root rise duration, level 1
0.simple: How long the level-1 root takes to rise.
0.technical: PlantRootMove state 1 selects this value for SpawnCursedEnergyLevel == 1 and passes 0.5 seconds (multiplied by the pattern-1 Rate from row 0 value 1) to Rise.Start(0, 3000, Duration). The matching damage row is CP_150_ATTACKG_01_01_1.

1.label: Root rise duration, level 2
1.simple: How long the level-2 root takes to rise.
1.technical: Same as value 0 for SpawnCursedEnergyLevel == 2, using row 0 value 2 as the pattern-1 divisor. Damage row: CP_150_ATTACKG_01_01_2.

2.label: Root rise duration, level 3
2.simple: How long the level-3 root takes to rise.
2.technical: Same as value 0 for SpawnCursedEnergyLevel == 3, using row 0 value 3 as the pattern-1 divisor. Damage row: CP_150_ATTACKG_01_01_3.

3.label: Root trap placement range, level 1
3.simple: How far from the character the level-1 root trap can be placed.
3.technical: TCP_150_CursedEnergyAttack_1<TBase>::GetTrapRange writes 2000 world-space units for action cursed energy level 1. UniqueAction clamps the secondary target's XY position to that range around the owner before grounding and spawning TR_030_00.

4.label: Root trap placement range, level 2
4.simple: How far from the character the level-2 root trap can be placed.
4.technical: GetTrapRange writes 3000 world-space units for level 2; the same XY clamp applies to the TR_030_00 spawn target.

5.label: Root trap placement range, level 3
5.simple: How far from the character the level-3 root trap can be placed.
5.technical: GetTrapRange writes 4000 world-space units for level 3; the same XY clamp applies to the TR_030_00 spawn target.

6.label: Root trap initial wait, level 1
6.simple: How long the level-1 trap sits before its root attack begins.
6.technical: PlantRootMove::Start assigns 0.3 seconds to Timer for level 1. Tick state 0 decrements that Timer; when it reaches <= 0 it spawns FX_CP_150_00211 and advances. The pattern-1 Rate from row 0 value 1 multiplies this Timer in Start before ticking.

7.label: Root trap initial wait, level 2
7.simple: How long the level-2 trap sits before its root attack begins.
7.technical: Same state-0 countdown for level 2, initialized to 0.3 seconds and multiplied by the pattern-1 Rate from row 0 value 2.

8.label: Root trap initial wait, level 3
8.simple: How long the level-3 trap sits before its root attack begins.
8.technical: Same state-0 countdown for level 3, initialized to 0.2 seconds and multiplied by the pattern-1 Rate from row 0 value 3.

notes.text: The same CE_1 slot-3 body is used for ground/air and Auto variants; the Auto variant changes both GetTrapRange and the SpawnFlag passed into AGameTrapManager::InitializeTrap, which is why row 7 can replace these level values.
PlantRootMove uses GetUniqueFloat, which returns 0 immediately when the trap has no source interface; otherwise it forwards to that source character's GetCharacterUniqueFloatValue.

CP_150_ATTACKH_1.title: Cursed-energy-2 homing wall, level 1
CP_150_ATTACKH_1.overview: Settings for the level-1 homing shot and the PlantWall traps it lays. The same row is selected dynamically by the controller's cursed energy level; the level also picks the plant-wall damage row.

0.label: PlantWall trap count
0.simple: How many homing wall traps one cursed-energy-2 shot lays.
0.technical: AddHomingShot converts value 0 of this row to int32 and stores it as FCP_150_HomingShot::SpawnCount. TickHomingShots stops a shot's spawning once SpawnIndex reaches that count (3 here). Even counts spawn two traps per batch; odd counts spawn one after the first.

1.label: Minimum wall spawn radius
1.simple: Closest distance from the shot origin at which a wall can be placed.
1.technical: Stored as SpawnRadiusMin. Each step computes Distance = Lerp(SpawnRadiusMin, SpawnRadiusMax, abs(cos(Step * Spread))) and offsets the candidate trap location by that world-space distance along the fanned direction.

2.label: Maximum wall spawn radius
2.simple: Farthest distance from the shot origin at which a wall can be placed.
2.technical: Stored as SpawnRadiusMax and used as the upper endpoint of the same Lerp for every wall candidate.

3.label: Wall fan spread
3.simple: How widely the homing walls are fanned around the shot direction.
3.technical: Stored as SpawnSpreadAngleDegrees (47 degrees). At batch 0 with an even trap count it is halved; otherwise the direction is rotated by +/-(Step * Spread) degrees around the shot's up axis, alternating sides within the batch. The same scaled value is the argument to the cosine used by the distance Lerp.

4.label: Wall wave interval
4.simple: How long between successive waves of homing walls.
4.technical: Value 4 of this row is Unique4 in AddHomingShot. ScaledInterval = (passive active ? 1/row0 value 4 : 1) * Unique4 is stored as SpawnInterval; after a batch actually spawns a trap, SpawnTimer is reset to SpawnInterval. Zero divisor falls back to a multiplier of 1.

5.label: Wall rise duration
5.simple: How long the plant wall takes to rise.
5.technical: FGameTrapAction_PlantWall picks this row by cursed energy level (4/5/6), then multiplies value 5 by the pattern-1 Rate from row 0 value 4 and passes it to Rise.Start. With no pattern 1 the duration is the raw 0.25 seconds.

6.label: Wall post-rise hold
6.simple: How long the wall stays active after it finishes rising.
6.technical: PlantWall state 0 assigns value 6 of this row to Timer (2 seconds). State 2 decrements that Timer and finishes the trap action when it is <= 0, if the controller has no unfinished action.

7.label: Wall rise height factor
7.simple: How high each plant wall rises.
7.technical: PlantWall computes RiseHeight = value 7 * 500.0 and passes it to Rise.Start. Here that gives 250 world-space units for this level.

8.label: Homing shot start delay
8.simple: How long after the cursed-energy-2 shot is created before walls appear.
8.technical: AddHomingShot stores value 8 as FCP_150_HomingShot::SpawnDelay. TickHomingShots decrements it by the dilation-adjusted Delta and skips the shot while it remains > 0 before starting the SpawnTimer countdown.

notes.text: Ground CursedEnergyAttack_2 calls AddHomingShot on start count 0 and air CursedEnergyAttackAir_2 on start count 2. Both snap the start Z to ground and aim in 2-D at the secondary target, falling back to the owner's forward vector if no valid target or a zero direction.

AddHomingShot chooses rows 4/5/6 from the controller's cursed energy level, not from the function's Level argument; levels outside 1-3 leave Row at -1 and no fallback is applied before the unchecked float getter.
Wall traps use alternating TR_031_00 and TR_031_10 rows, record their weak handles on the shot, and report hits back to the controller so a previously hit actor is not collided with again.

CP_150_ATTACKG_AUTO.title: Auto root-rise overrides
CP_150_ATTACKG_AUTO.overview: Overrides for the Auto cursed-energy-1 attacks: one rise time, one placement range and one zero initial wait. SpawnFlag 1 on the TR_030_00 trap selects these instead of the level-based ATTACKG values.

0.label: Auto root rise duration
0.simple: How long the auto root takes to rise.
0.technical: PlantRootMove state 1 checks SpawnFlag == 1 and replaces the level duration with GetUniqueFloat(0, 7), i.e. 0.25 seconds, before applying the row-0 pattern-1 Rate. The damage row is forced to CP_150_ATTACKG_01_01_1.

1.label: Auto trap placement range
1.simple: How far from the character the auto root trap can be placed.
1.technical: FCP_150_CursedEnergyAttack_1_Auto and FCP_150_CursedEnergyAttackAir_1_Auto override GetTrapRange to write 4000 world-space units. UniqueAction then uses that range to clamp the secondary target's XY position before spawning TR_030_00.

2.label: Auto root initial wait
2.simple: How long the auto trap waits before its attack begins.
2.technical: PlantRootMove::Start checks SpawnFlag == 1 and sets Timer directly from value 2 of row 7, or 0 if there is no source interface. Because the value is 0, state 0 proceeds on its first tick. Row 0's pattern-1 Rate still multiplies this Timer in Start.

notes.text: Auto status is decided by the action type (CursedEnergyAttack_1_Auto or Air_1_Auto), then passed as the SpawnFlag to InitializeTrap; the same true flag is also used in the collision-parameter Setup call for the root trap.

AGameCharacter creates this controller only for EGameCharacterActionControllerType::CP_150. Its CreateAction override supplies Hanami-specific normal and cursed-energy actions for sixteen types and delegates all other types to the base factory.

The behaviour controller is a size-zero shell for this character: AI index 0x10 gets FGameCharacterAIAction_NormalAttack3DownHold, matching the held third-attack mechanic; every other index delegates to the parent factory.

The CP_150 AI setup uses advanced behaviour, close/mid ranges of 1000/500/1500, weights 20 for both cursed-energy attacks and 30 for the super, and gates normal-attack 3/3_1 and cursed-energy 2 on value D being at least 4.

The shared trap helper GetUniqueFloat returns 0 if a trap has no source interface; the character action helper GetOwnerUniqueFloat directly calls the owner character's float getter. Neither adds row-index bounds safety.
The shared TR_030_00 spawn tail is also used by CP_130 cursed-energy slot 3 bodies, but the row meanings here are CP_150's: do not transfer them to another character code that reuses the row names.
